game_concept: A adventure race set in Coastal Port – Tidepool Cove, a tidepool cove: the dock cartographer must handle kraken tentacles while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Rule Duel: Write rules that beat the AI's chosen move in a best-of-rounds duel.
theme: Coastal Port – Tidepool Cove: a tidepool cove
core_gameplay_loop: In Tidepool Cove, repeat each round: Write rules that beat the AI's chosen move in a best-of-rounds duel. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the dock cartographer ahead. Then check the duel_hp value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the lighthouse lamp by solving code steps involving duel_hp that move the dock cartographer forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.0).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the lighthouse lamp first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 8 (extended tier): Rule Duel
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rule Duel' (Week 3 slot 11), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Tidepool Cove'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how duel_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against kraken tentacles in Tidepool Cove.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.0).
